bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for a grant to Bolder Options youth mentoring program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; EARLY CAREER EXPLORATION IN PUBLIC SERVICE. +]

[+$175,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to Bolder Options youth mentoring program for the purpose of creating a pilot program to provide youth, ages 12 to 21, with exposure to career pathways in public service, including opportunities through the Minnesota Army National Guard. The pilot program will operate in the cities of Minneapolis, St. Paul, and Rochester. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for a grant to Bolder Options youth mentoring program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; EARLY CAREER EXPLORATION IN PUBLIC SERVICE.

$175,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to Bolder Options youth mentoring program for the purpose of creating a pilot program to provide youth, ages 12 to 21, with exposure to career pathways in public service, including opportunities through the Minnesota Army National Guard. The pilot program will operate in the cities of Minneapolis, St. Paul, and Rochester. This is a onetime appropriation.
